, physical safety, and resources exist around this person?',
          o: 'Observes poverty, community violence, legal protections, healthcare access, and physical shelter.',
          l: 'Without environment, psychology commits the error of pathologizing people for having normal reactions to unsafe conditions.'
        },
        'CULTURE': {
          q: 'How does this community construct meaning, ritual, spiritual resonance, and collective witnessing?',
          o: 'Observes cultural idioms of distress, traditional healing frameworks, and historical trauma narratives.',
          l: 'Without culture, Western psychiatric categories are falsely exported as culture-free universal truth.'
        },
        'MEANING': {
          q: 'What narrative meaning does the survivor assign to this experience?',
          o: 'Observes moral injury, existential crisis, shattered core assumptions, and post-traumatic integration.',
          l: 'Without meaning, symptom reduction leaves the human heart without purpose or peace.'
        },
        'SYSTEMS': {
          q: 'How do institutional policies, power hierarchies, and disciplinary codes resist retraumatization?',
          o: 'Observes institutional betrayal, school disciplinary traps, workplace policies, and upstream prevention.',
          l: 'Without systems thinking, organizations lecture traumatized individuals on grit while perpetuating harm.'
        }
      };

      const info = lensDetails[lens];
      if (info) {
        d.innerHTML = `
          <div class="font-bold text-sm text-[#3e6892] dark:text-[#edae9d] font-serif-editorial">The ${lens} Lens: "${info.q}"</div>
          <div class="text-xs text-[#263238] dark:text-stone-300 mt-1"><strong>What it observes:</strong> ${info.o}</div>
          <div class="text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#7D4A3C] font-bold mt-1.5"><strong>Why it is incomplete alone:</strong> ${info.l}</div>
        `;
      }
    }

    // 2. LESSON VIEW RENDERER (HIGH-END EDITORIAL REDESIGN)

      return `

                <!-- Collapsible Transcript & Summary Panel -->

          <!-- Opening Hook Card -->

              <div class="font-bold flex items-center justify-between text-[#3A5648] dark:text-emerald-300 uppercase tracking-wider text-xs">
                <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><i data-lucide="compass" class="w-4 h-4 text-[#edae9d]"></i> Evidence Compass Classification</span>
                <button onclick="toggleModal('modal-evidence-compass')" class="underline hover:text-emerald-700 text-[11px] font-sans">Open Evidence Key</button>
              </div>

          <!-- Plain-Language Terminology -->

              <div class="font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#4A5C66] text-[10px]">Plain-Language Terminology</div>
              <p class="text-[#263238] dark:text-stone-300 leading-relaxed">${les.terms}</p>

          ` : ''}

          <!-- Non-Graphic Case Vignette -->
          ${les.example ? `

              <div class="font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-300 text-[10px] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <i data-lucide="file-text" class="w-3.5 h-3.5"></i> Non-Graphic Case Vignette

          ` : ''}

          <!-- Common Misconception Callout -->
          ${les.misconception ? `

              <div class="font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-900 dark:text-rose-300 text-[10px] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <i data-lucide="alert-triangle" class="w-3.5 h-3.5"></i> Common Misconception Challenged
              </div>
              <p class="text-[#814A57] dark:text-rose-100 leading-relaxed">${les.misconception}</p>
            </div>
          ` : ''}

          <!-- Look Through Another Lens (Tabbed Interactive Explorer) -->

                <span class="text-xs uppercase font-extrabold tracking-wider text-[#3e6892] dark:text-[#edae9d]">Look Through Another Lens</span>
                <h4 class="text-xs text-[#4A5C66] dark:text-[#617B8A]">What changes when the perspective changes?</h4>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5" id="lens-tabs-${les.id}">
              ${['Neuroscience', 'Development', 'Relationships', 'Culture', 'Systems'].map((tab, idx) => `
                <button onclick="switchLessonLens('${les.id}', '${tab}')" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 hover:bg-stone-100 dark:hover:bg-stone-700 transition ${idx === 0 ? 'bg-[#3e6892] text-white border-transparent' : 'text-[#263238] dark:text-stone-300'}">
                  ${tab}
                </button>
              `).join('')}
            </div>
            <div id="lens-content-${les.id}" class="p-4 bg-[#FAF6F7] dark:bg-stone-900 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#172126] dark:text-stone-200 italic leading-relaxed border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700">
              Examining through Neuroscience: What autonomic circuits, noradrenergic floods, and neural networks are mobilizing survival resources?
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Knowledge Check -->
          ${les.quiz ? `
            <div class="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-stone-800 border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 shadow-md space-y-4">
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span class="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs">?</span>
                <h3 class="font-bold text-sm text-[#172126] dark:text-[#FAF6F7]">Formative Knowledge Check</h3>
              </div>
              <div class="text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#263238] dark:text-stone-300 leading-relaxed space-y-2">
                ${formatQuizText(les.quiz, les.id)}
              </div>
            </div>
          ` : ''}

          <!-- Private Reflection Card -->
          <div class="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-[#FAF6F7] dark:bg-stone-800/90 border border-[#bbd4c5] dark:border-stone-700 space-y-3 shadow-sm">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span class="text-xs uppercase font-extrabold tracking-wider text-[#edae9d] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <i data-lucide="lock" class="w-3.5 h-3.5"></i> Private Reflection Card
              </span>
              <span class="text-[10px] text-[#4A5C66] font-medium">Stored locally on your device</span>
            </div>
            <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#263238] dark:text-stone-300 font-light">
              ${les.reflection || 'What idea became clearer in this lesson? What assumption did you hold that changed?'}
            </p>
            <textarea id="reflection-input-${les.id}" rows="2" placeholder="Write privately here (optional)..." class="w-full p-3 rounded-xl border border-stone-300 dark:border-stone-600 bg-white dark:bg-stone-900 text-xs sm:text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3e6892] focus:outline-none">${savedReflection}</textarea>
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between pt-1">
              <button onclick="saveLessonReflection('${les.id}')" class="px-4 py-2 bg-[#3e6892] text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-[#172126] transition shadow-sm">Save Privately</button>
              <span id="reflection-save-status-${les.id}" class="text-xs text-emerald-600 font-medium hidden">Saved to local device ✓</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Bottom Lesson Navigation Controls -->
          <div class="pt-6 border-t border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <button onclick="navigateStep(-1)" class="px-5 py-2.5 border border-stone-300 dark:border-stone-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold hover:bg-stone-100 dark:hover:bg-stone-800 transition flex items-center gap-2">

              Next Lesson <i data-lucide="chevron-right" class="w-4 h-4"></i>

        </article>
      `;
    }

    function switchLessonLens(lesId, tab) {
      const c = document.getElementById(`lens-content-${lesId}`);
      if (!c) return;
      const texts = {
        'Neuroscience': 'Examining through Neuroscience: What autonomic circuits, noradrenergic floods, and neural networks are mobilizing survival resources?',
        'Development': 'Examining through Development: At what life stage did this occur, and what cognitive hardware was active at that age?',
        'Relationships': 'Examining through Relationships: How does relational attunement or betrayal shape whether this experience can be safely integrated?',
        'Culture': 'Examining through Culture: How do shared communal rituals, heritage, and idioms of distress construct meaning around this event?',
        'Systems': 'Examining through Systems: What institutional policies, economic conditions, and power dynamics surround this human being?'
      };
      c.innerText = texts[tab] || 'Examining through alternate perspective.';
    }

    function escQ(s){return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/\*\*/g,'').replace(/(^|\s)\*([^*]+)\*(?=\s|$|[.,;])/g,'$1$2');}
    function parseQuiz(raw){
      const items=[]; let cur=null;
      raw.split('\n').forEach(function(ln){
        const q=ln.match(/^\s*(\d+)\.\s+(.*)$/), o=ln.match(/^\s*-\s+([A-E])\)\s+(.*)$/),
              a=ln.match(/\*\*Answer:\s*([A-E])/), e=ln.match(/\*Explanation:\*\s*(.*)$/);
        if(q && !o){cur={q:q[2],opts:[],ans:null,exp:''};items.push(cur);}
        else if(o && cur){cur.opts.push({k:o[1],t:o[2]});}
        else if(a && cur){cur.ans=a[1];}
        else if(e && cur){cur.exp=e[1];}
      });
      return items.filter(function(i){return i.opts.length>=2 && i.ans;});
    }
    function formatQuizText(rawQuiz, lesId){
      const items=parseQuiz(rawQuiz);
      if(!items.length){return escQ(rawQuiz).split('\n').join('<br>');}
      return items.map(function(it,qi){
        let s=0; const key=lesId+'-'+qi; for(let i=0;i<key.length;i++){s=(s*31+key.charCodeAt(i))>>>0;}
        const rnd=function(){s=(s*1664525+1013904223)>>>0;return s/4294967296;};
        const opts=it.opts.map(function(o){return {t:o.t,correct:o.k===it.ans};});
        for(let i=opts.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(rnd()*(i+1));const t=opts[i];opts[i]=opts[j];opts[j]=t;}
        const gid='quiz-'+String(lesId).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g,'')+'-'+qi;
        const letters=['A','B','C','D','E'];
        return `
          <div id="${gid}" class="space-y-3" role="group" aria-labelledby="${gid}-q">
            <p id="${gid}-q" class="font-semibold text-[#172126] dark:text-[#FAF6F7] leading-relaxed">${escQ(it.q)}</p>
            <div class="space-y-2">
              ${opts.map(function(o,oi){return `
              <button type="button" data-opt="1" data-correct="${o.correct}" onclick="answerQuiz('${gid}',this)"
                class="w-full text-left flex gap-3 items-start p-3 rounded-xl border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 bg-white dark:bg-stone-900 hover:border-evergreen dark:hover:border-clay transition-colors">
                <span class="shrink-0 w-6 h-6 rounded-full border border-stone-300 dark:border-stone-600 flex items-center justify-center text-[11px] font-bold">${letters[oi]}</span>
                <span class="flex-1">${escQ(o.t)} <span data-tag class="ml-1 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider"></span></span>
              </button>`;}).join('')}
            </div>
            <div data-feedback class="hidden p-4 rounded-xl border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 bg-[#FAF6F7] dark:bg-stone-800" role="status" aria-live="polite">
              <p data-verdict class="font-bold mb-1"></p>
              <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm leading-relaxed">${escQ(it.exp||'')}</p>
              <button type="button" onclick="resetQuiz('${gid}')" class="mt-3 text-xs font-semibold underline underline-offset-2 text-evergreen dark:text-clay">Try this question again</button>
            </div>
          </div>`;
      }).join('<hr class="border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 my-4">');
    }
    function answerQuiz(gid, btn){
      const wrap=document.getElementById(gid); if(!wrap || wrap.dataset.done==='1'){return;}
      wrap.dataset.done='1';
      const ok=btn.dataset.correct==='true';
      wrap.querySelectorAll('button[data-opt]').forEach(function(b){
        b.disabled=true; b.setAttribute('aria-disabled','true');
        const tag=b.querySelector('[data-tag]');
        if(b.dataset.correct==='true'){b.classList.remove('border-stone-200','dark:border-stone-700');b.classList.add('border-2','border-emerald-700','bg-emerald-100','dark:bg-emerald-950/40'); if(tag){tag.textContent='✓ Correct answer';}}
        else if(b===btn){b.classList.remove('border-stone-200','dark:border-stone-700');b.classList.add('border-2','border-rose-600','bg-rose-100','dark:bg-rose-950/40'); if(tag){tag.textContent='Your choice';}}
        else{b.classList.add('opacity-60');}
      });
      const fb=wrap.querySelector('[data-feedback]'); fb.classList.remove('hidden');
      fb.querySelector('[data-verdict]').textContent= ok ? 'That is right.' : 'Not quite. Here is the reasoning.';
    }
    function resetQuiz(gid){
      const wrap=document.getElementById(gid); if(!wrap){return;}
      wrap.dataset.done='';
      wrap.querySelectorAll('button[data-opt]').forEach(function(b){
        b.disabled=false; b.removeAttribute('aria-disabled');
        b.classList.remove('border-2','border-emerald-700','bg-emerald-100','dark:bg-emerald-950/40','border-rose-600','bg-rose-100','dark:bg-rose-950/40','opacity-60');b.classList.add('border-stone-200','dark:border-stone-700');
        const tag=b.querySelector('[data-tag]'); if(tag){tag.textContent='';}
      });
      wrap.querySelector('[data-feedback]').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function saveLessonReflection(lesId) {
      const val = document.getElementById(`reflection-input-${lesId}`)?.value;
      if (val !== undefined) {
        state.reflections[lesId] = val;
        saveState();
        const stat = document.getElementById(`reflection-save-status-${lesId}`);
        if (stat) {
          stat.classList.remove('hidden');
          setTimeout(() => stat.classList.add('hidden'), 2500);
        }
      }
    }

    function toggleLessonComplete(lesId) {
      if (state.completedLessons.has(lesId)) {
        state.completedLessons.delete(lesId);
      } else {
        state.completedLessons.add(lesId);
      }
      saveState();
      renderSidebar();
      renderView();
    }

    function navigateStep(direction) {
      const mod = courseData[state.currentModIdx];
      let newLesIdx = state.currentLesIdx + direction;
      let newModIdx = state.currentModIdx;

      if (newLesIdx >= mod.lessons.length) {
        navigateTo('module_review', newModIdx, mod.lessons.length - 1);
        return;
      } else if (newLesIdx < 0) {
        if (newModIdx > 0) {
          newModIdx--;
          newLesIdx = courseData[newModIdx].lessons.length - 1;
        } else {
          navigateTo('arrival');
          return;
        }
      }

      navigateTo('lesson', newModIdx, newLesIdx);
    }

    // 3. CONTEXT MATRIX WORKBENCH VIEW
    function getContextMatrixViewHTML() {
      return `
        <div class="space-y-6">
          <div class="space-y-2 pb-4 border-b border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700">
            <span class="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest font-extrabold text-[#3e6892] dark:text-[#edae9d]">Signature Framework</span>
            <h1 class="font-serif-editorial text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold text-[#172126] dark:text-[#FAF6F7]">The Context Matrix Workbench</h1>
            <p class="text-sm text-[#2F3F48] dark:text-stone-300">
              Human response cannot be predicted from external events alone. Use this interactive console to reveal how 10 contextual dimensions fundamentally alter what we can responsibly conclude.
            </p>
          </div>

          <!-- Scenario Header -->
          <div class="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-stone-800 border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 space-y-2 shadow-sm">
            <span class="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#edae9d]">Case Investigation</span>
            <p class="text-sm font-medium text-[#172126] dark:text-stone-200 leading-relaxed font-serif-editorial">
              "Jordan, a 34-year-old regional employee, was involved in an industrial machinery collapse at work. Jordan suffered superficial bruises, was examined at the clinic, and discharged. Three weeks later, Jordan has been completely unable to return to work, experiences intense daily panic attacks, and avoids leaving home."
            </p>
          </div>

          <!-- Dynamic Trajectory Meter -->
          <div class="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-stone-800 border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 shadow-sm flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div>
              <span class="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider text-[#4A5C66]">Predicted Ecological Strain:</span>
              <div id="cm-strain-label" class="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-rose-600">Initial Observation: Disproportionate Reaction (85% Unexplained)</div>
            </div>
            <div class="w-full sm:w-56 bg-stone-200 dark:bg-stone-700 h-3 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
              <div id="cm-strain-bar" class="bg-rose-600 h-full w-[85%] transition-all duration-300"></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- 10 Interactive Dimension Tiles -->
          <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3" id="cm-tiles-grid">
            ${[
              { id: 1, title: '1. When in Time?', detail: 'Jordans spouse was diagnosed with advanced leukemia 3 weeks prior; medical bills have exhausted family savings.' },
              { id: 2, title: '2. At What Developmental Stage?', detail: 'Jordan is an adult carrying sole financial dependency for two young children.' },
              { id: 3, title: '3. In What Relationship?', detail: 'The equipment was known to be faulty; supervisors ignored Jordans written warnings twice (Institutional Betrayal).' },
              { id: 4, title: '4. Power & Control Conditions?', detail: 'During the collapse, Jordan was pinned by steel beams in darkness for 40 minutes listening to sirens.' },
              { id: 5, title: '5. Perceived Agency?', detail: 'Jordan was completely immobilized and unable to reach an emergency shutoff valve.' },
              { id: 6, title: '6. Cumulative Adversity Load?', detail: 'Jordan grew up in an unpredictable household with domestic violence; threat baseline was already elevated.' },
              { id: 7, title: '7. Immediate Buffering & Support?', detail: 'Company HR called twice the next day demanding accident report forms without asking about injuries.' },
              { id: 8, title: '8. Resources & Safe Housing?', detail: 'Jordans apartment lease expires in 14 days; missing a paycheck means immediate eviction.' },
              { id: 9, title: '9. Cultural & Meaning Context?', detail: 'Jordans community prizes stoic silence, leaving Jordan isolated with intense shame.' },
              { id: 10, title: '10. Is the Threat Over?', detail: 'The factory has not repaired the machinery; returning means facing active physical danger.' }
            ].map(tile => `
              <div id="cm-tile-${tile.id}" onclick="revealContextTile(${tile.id})" class="p-4 rounded-xl border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 bg-white dark:bg-stone-800 hover:border-[#3e6892] cursor-pointer transition shadow-sm">
                <div class="font-bold text-xs text-[#3e6892] dark:text-[#edae9d] flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span>${tile.title}</span>
                  <span id="cm-tile-icon-${tile.id}" class="text-[#617B8A] text-[10px] uppercase font-mono">Click to reveal</span>
                </div>
                <div id="cm-tile-body-${tile.id}" class="text-xs text-[#263238] dark:text-stone-300 mt-2 hidden leading-relaxed">
                  ${tile.detail}
                </div>
              </div>
            `).join('')}
          </div>

          <!-- Final Takeaway Banner -->
          <div class="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-[#FAF6F7] dark:bg-stone-800 border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 text-center space-y-2">
            <h3 class="font-bold text-base text-[#172126] dark:text-[#FAF6F7]">Observation is Not Etiology</h3>
            <p class="text-xs max-w-xl mx-auto text-[#2F3F48] dark:text-stone-300 leading-relaxed font-light">
              When we only knew "machinery collapse + minor bruises," Jordans severe collapse seemed baffling. When the Context Matrix revealed pinned entrapment, caregiver depletion, eviction threat, and ongoing danger, Jordans response becomes completely understandable.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    const revealedSet = new Set();
    function revealContextTile(id) {
      const body = document.getElementById(`cm-tile-body-${id}`);
      const icon = document.getElementById(`cm-tile-icon-${id}`);
      const tile = document.getElementById(`cm-tile-${id}`);
      if (!body) return;

      if (body.classList.contains('hidden')) {
        body.classList.remove('hidden');
        if (icon) icon.innerText = 'Revealed ✓';
        if (tile) tile.classList.add('bg-emerald-50', 'dark:bg-emerald-950/30', 'border-emerald-500');
        revealedSet.add(id);
      }

      const count = revealedSet.size;
      const bar = document.getElementById('cm-strain-bar');
      const lbl = document.getElementById('cm-strain-label');
      if (bar && lbl) {
        const pct = Math.max(15, 85 - (count * 7));
        bar.style.width = pct + '%';
        if (count >= 7) {
          bar.className = 'bg-emerald-600 h-full transition-all duration-300';
          lbl.className = 'text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300';
          lbl.innerText = `Full Context Integrated (${count}/10 Revealed): Logical Survival Adaptation`;
        } else {
          lbl.innerText = `Integrating Context (${count}/10 Revealed): Explanatory Picture Forming`;
        }
      }
    }

    // 4. CLAIM LAB SUITE VIEW
    function getClaimLabViewHTML() {
      return `
        <div class="space-y-6">
          <div class="space-y-2 pb-4 border-b border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700">

            <h1 class="font-serif-editorial text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold text-[#172126] dark:text-[#FAF6F7]">The Claim Lab Suite</h1>
            <p class="text-sm text-[#2F3F48] dark:text-stone-300">

          <div class="space-y-4">

              <div class="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-stone-800 border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 shadow-sm space-y-3">

                  <button onclick="evaluateClaim('${c.id}', 'partly')" class="p-2.5 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50/50 dark:bg-emerald-950/20 rounded-lg font-bold text-[#3A5648] dark:text-emerald-200">Partly Accurate</button>
                  <button onclick="evaluateClaim('${c.id}', 'too_strong')" class="p-2.5 border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-stone-50 dark:hover:bg-stone-700 font-medium">Too Strong</button>
                  <button onclick="evaluateClaim('${c.id}', 'insufficient')" class="p-2.5 border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-stone-50 dark:hover:bg-stone-700 font-medium">Insufficient Data</button>

                <!-- Hidden Deconstruction Results -->

                    <strong>What it gets right:</strong> ${c.right}

                  <div class="p-3.5 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/30 rounded-xl text-[#814A57] dark:text-rose-100">
                    <strong>Where it goes too far:</strong> ${c.overreach}

                  <div class="p-3.5 bg-stone-100 dark:bg-stone-700/40 rounded-xl text-[#172126] dark:text-stone-200">

              <div class="font-bold text-sm text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300">State: Ventral Vagal Social Engagement</div>

              <button onclick="selectBrainNetwork('cen')" class="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-stone-100 dark:hover:bg-stone-700 text-[#172126] dark:text-stone-200">Central Executive (Regulation)</button>
              <button onclick="selectBrainNetwork('dmn')" class="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-stone-100 dark:hover:bg-stone-700 text-[#172126] dark:text-stone-200">Default Mode (Self-Narrative)</button>
            </div>

    function updateANSState(val) {
      const card = document.getElementById('ans-state-card');
      if (!card) return;
      if (val == 1) {
        card.className = 'p-4 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 border border-emerald-300 text-xs space-y-1.5 text-[#3A5648] dark:text-emerald-100';
        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="font-bold text-sm text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300">State 1: Ventral Vagal Social Engagement</div>
          <div>• Heart Rate: Regulated with healthy respiratory sinus arrhythmia (variability).</div>
          <div>• Digestion & Immune: Fully active, cellular tissue repair occurring.</div>
          <div>• Perception: Wide visual field, responsive facial attunement, open curiosity.</div>
        `;
      } else if (val == 2) {
        card.className = 'p-4 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-300 text-xs space-y-1.5 text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-100';
        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="font-bold text-sm text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300">State 2: Sympathetic Mobilization (Fight or Flight)</div>
          <div>• Heart Rate: Spikes rapidly, blood pressure surges, adrenaline release.</div>
          <div>• Digestion & Immune: Suspended; blood redirected exclusively to large skeletal muscles.</div>
          <div>• Perception: Tunnel vision, hyper-scanning for physical exits, executive narrative paused.</div>
        `;
      } else {
        card.className = 'p-4 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/30 border border-blue-300 text-xs space-y-1.5 text-[#243C54] dark:text-blue-100';
        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="font-bold text-sm text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300">State 3: Dorsal Vagal Collapse (Defensive Freeze / Numbing)</div>
          <div>• Heart Rate: Drops precipitously, metabolic slowing, fainting/paralysis.</div>
          <div>• Neurochemistry: Endogenous opioid release providing biological anesthesia against pain.</div>
          <div>• Perception: Depersonalization, feeling far away, glassy stare, total verbal shutdown.</div>
        `;
      }
    }

    function selectBrainNetwork(net) {
      const card = document.getElementById('brain-network-card');
      if (!card) return;
      if (net === 'salience') {
        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="font-bold text-sm text-[#172126] dark:text-[#FAF6F7]">The Salience Network (Amygdala, Anterior Insula)</div>
          <p>Acts as the sensory radar of the brain. In PTSD, the Salience Network fires with heightened sensitivity to sensory cues (smells, sounds, postures), detecting danger where safety exists because regulatory brakes are temporarily decoupled.</p>
        `;
      } else if (net === 'cen') {
        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="font-bold text-sm text-[#172126] dark:text-[#FAF6F7]">The Central Executive Network (dlPFC, Posterior Parietal)</div>
          <p>Governs working memory, conscious problem solving, and deliberate emotional regulation. During acute traumatic triggers, executive control can be sidelined by immediate subcortical threat mobilization.</p>
        `;
      } else {
        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="font-bold text-sm text-[#172126] dark:text-[#FAF6F7]">The Default Mode Network (mPFC, Posterior Cingulate)</div>
          <p>Active during internal reflection, autobiographical memory, and the sense of ego self. In chronic trauma, hyper-connectivity in the DMN frequently fuels repetitive rumination, intrusive memories, and toxic self-blame.</p>
        `;
      }
    }

    function setWindowZone(zone) {
      const d = document.getElementById('window-zone-detail');
      if (!d) return;
      if (zone === 'hyper') {
        d.innerHTML = `
          <strong class="text-rose-700">Hyperarousal (Sympathetic Flooding):</strong><br>
          Anxiety, panic, racing thoughts, insomnia, explosive anger, hypervigilance, and somatic tension. The nervous system believes an active battle is occurring right now.
        `;
      } else if (zone === 'optimal') {
        d.innerHTML = `
          <strong class="text-emerald-700">Optimal Window of Tolerance:</strong><br>
          Emotions can be felt deeply without overwhelming cognitive reasoning. Capacity for self-soothing, perspective-taking, curiosity, and intimate connection remains online.
        `;
      } else {
        d.innerHTML = `
          <strong class="text-blue-700">Hypoarousal (Dorsal Collapse / Freeze):</strong><br>
          Emotional numbness, dissociation, severe fatigue, emptiness, shame-collapse, anhedonia, and mental blankness. The nervous system has pulled the metabolic emergency brake.
        `;
      }
    }

    // 6. LIFESPAN TIMELINE VIEW
    function getLifespanViewHTML() {
      const epochs = [
        { name: 'Prenatal', age: 'In Utero', focus: 'Placental 11β-HSD2 enzyme buffers maternal cortisol; probabilistic vulnerability, heavily buffered by post-natal caregiving.' },
        { name: 'Infancy', age: '0–3 Years', focus: 'Inability to self-soothe; total reliance on caregiver co-regulation. Paradox of the frightening caregiver wires disorganized attachment.' },
        { name: 'Childhood', age: '4–11 Years', focus: 'Egocentrism and magical thinking lead children to internalize blame (&quot;I am bad&quot;) to maintain attachment to unsafe adults, birthing toxic shame.' },
        { name: 'Adolescence', age: '12–18 Years', focus: 'Synaptic remodeling and dopamine peaks vs. developing prefrontal brakes. Trauma collides directly with identity and peer belonging.' },
        { name: 'Adulthood', age: '19–64 Years', focus: 'Trauma shatters core assumptions of safety and fairness. Relational neuroplasticity permits &quot;Earned Security&quot; in safe adult bonds.' },
        { name: 'Older Age', age: '65+ Years', focus: 'Late-Onset Stress Symptomatology (LOSS). Retirement and bereavement remove lifelong coping distraction shields, resurfacing early trauma.' }
      ];

      return `
        <div class="space-y-6">
          <div class="space-y-2 pb-4 border-b border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700">
            <span class="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest font-extrabold text-[#edae9d]">Developmental Timing</span>
            <h1 class="font-serif-editorial text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold text-[#172126] dark:text-[#FAF6F7]">Interactive Lifespan Timeline</h1>
            <p class="text-sm text-[#2F3F48] dark:text-stone-300">
              Trauma strikes a living, changing organism across time. Select any developmental epoch to observe how hardware, relational buffers, and expression transform:
            </p>
          </div>

          <div class="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-6 gap-2" id="lifespan-epochs-bar">
            ${epochs.map((ep, idx) => `
              <button onclick="selectLifespanEpoch(${idx})" class="p-3 rounded-xl border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 text-center hover:border-[#3e6892] ${idx === 0 ? 'bg-[#3e6892] text-white border-transparent' : 'bg-white dark:bg-stone-800 text-[#172126] dark:text-stone-200'} transition">
                <div class="font-bold text-xs">${ep.name}</div>
                <div class="text-[10px] text-[#617B8A] font-mono">${ep.age}</div>
              </button>
            `).join('')}
          </div>

          <div id="lifespan-detail-card" class="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-stone-800 border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 shadow-sm space-y-3">
            <h3 class="font-serif-editorial text-xl font-bold text-[#172126] dark:text-[#FAF6F7]" id="ls-title">Prenatal Epoch</h3>
            <p class="text-sm text-[#263238] dark:text-stone-300 leading-relaxed font-light" id="ls-desc">
              Placental 11β-HSD2 enzyme buffers maternal cortisol; probabilistic developmental vulnerability, heavily buffered by post-natal caregiving and safe environments.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function selectLifespanEpoch(idx) {
      const epochs = [
        { name: 'Prenatal Epoch', desc: 'During in utero development, maternal stress hormones interact with placental enzymes. Population studies show statistical correlations with infant temperament, but correlation is not destiny: post-natal caregiving exerts massive protective effects.' },
        { name: 'Infancy Epoch (0–3 Years)', desc: 'Infants lack the neurological prefrontal hardware to self-soothe. They depend 100% on caregiver co-regulation (voice, gaze, touch). Chronic maltreatment creates disorganized attachment because the biological source of safety is also the source of terror.' },
        { name: 'Childhood Epoch (4–11 Years)', desc: 'Due to cognitive egocentrism and dependency, children believe their thoughts cause external events. A child internalizes blame (&quot;Bad things happen because I am bad&quot;) because believing a parent is unsafe is too terrifying for a dependent organism.' },
        { name: 'Adolescence Epoch (12–18 Years)', desc: 'Massive neural remodeling: synaptic pruning and myelination. Dopamine reward centers mature long before prefrontal impulse control brakes. Trauma during this stage intersects with identity formation, risk behaviors, and peer belonging.' },
        { name: 'Adulthood Epoch', desc: 'Adult trauma violently shatters core assumptions: &quot;The world is predictable, people are good, and I am in control.&quot; Relational intimacy feels dangerous. However, adult brains exhibit neuroplasticity; &quot;Earned Security&quot; is achievable through healthy relationships.' },
        { name: 'Older Adulthood & Elderhood', desc: 'Late-Onset Stress Symptomatology (LOSS). Lifelong work routines and parenting act as distraction shields keeping trauma memories suppressed. When retirement, bereavement, or physical frailty arrives, past trauma frequently floods back.' }
      ];

      const t = document.getElementById('ls-title');
      const d = document.getElementById('ls-desc');
      if (t && d && epochs[idx]) {
        t.innerText = epochs[idx].name;
        d.innerText = epochs[idx].desc;
      }
    }

    // 7. TREATMENT LANDSCAPE EXPLORER VIEW
    function getTreatmentExplorerViewHTML() {
      const treatments = [
        { name: 'Prolonged Exposure (PE)', tier: 'Established (First-Line)', target: 'PTSD Intrusions & Avoidance', desc: 'Gradual, safe, collaborative therapeutic engagement with avoided trauma memories and real-world reminders to foster extinction learning.' },
        { name: 'Cognitive Processing Therapy (CPT)', tier: 'Established (First-Line)', target: 'Trauma Beliefs & Stuck Points', desc: 'Structured therapy evaluating and updating unhelpful beliefs related to safety, trust, power, and guilt resulting from trauma.' },
        { name: 'EMDR', tier: 'Established (First-Line)', target: 'Trauma Memory Desensitization', desc: 'Standardized 8-phase protocol pairing memory recall with bilateral sensory stimulation (eye movements/taps) to process traumatic memories.' },
        { name: 'DBT-PTSD', tier: 'Specialized (Complex)', target: 'Severe Emotion Dysregulation & Abuse', desc: 'Validated in Bohus trials combining dialectical behavior regulation skills with exposure for complex childhood abuse survivors.' },
        { name: 'SSRIs & SNRIs (Sertraline, Paroxetine)', tier: 'Established (Pharmacotherapy)', target: 'Stabilization & Symptom Dampening', desc: 'FDA-approved medications that support neurotransmitter stabilization. Guidelines explicitly recommend against benzodiazepines.' },
        { name: 'Trauma-Sensitive Yoga & Somatic Adjuncts', tier: 'Adjunctive (Promising)', target: 'Interoception & Bodily Regulation', desc: 'Body- and movement-oriented practices restoring interoceptive safety and calming hyperarousal; moderate effect size with high study heterogeneity.' },
        { name: 'Ketamine-Assisted Psychotherapy (KAP)', tier: 'Emerging / Investigational', target: 'Treatment-Resistant PTSD & Depression', desc: 'Sub-anesthetic ketamine blocks NMDA receptors, releasing BDNF to open a 48-hour neuroplastic window for psychotherapeutic integration.' }
      ];

      return `
        <div class="space-y-6">
          <div class="space-y-2 pb-4 border-b border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700">
            <span class="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest font-extrabold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">Clinical Evidence</span>
            <h1 class="font-serif-editorial text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold text-[#172126] dark:text-[#FAF6F7]">The Treatment Landscape Directory</h1>
            <p class="text-sm text-[#2F3F48] dark:text-stone-300">
              Compare guideline-supported psychotherapies, medications, somatic adjuncts, and emerging medical treatments without miracle cure hype.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div class="space-y-3">
            ${treatments.map(t => `
              <div class="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-stone-800 border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 shadow-sm space-y-2">
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <h3 class="font-serif-editorial font-bold text-base sm:text-lg text-[#172126] dark:text-[#FAF6F7]">${t.name}</h3>
                  <span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-[#3A5648] border border-emerald-300 shrink-0">${t.tier}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="text-xs text-[#edae9d] font-semibold">Target: ${t.target}</div>
                <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#263238] dark:text-stone-300 leading-relaxed font-light">${t.desc}</p>
              </div>
            `).join('')}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    // 8. CONVERSATION SIMULATOR VIEW
    function getConversationSimViewHTML() {
      const scenarios = {
        workplace: {
          id: 'workplace',
          title: 'Workplace Acute Overwhelm',
          role: 'Alex (Senior Project Lead)',
          setting: 'Closed door 1-on-1 performance review following aggressive re-org',
          initialAutonomic: 'Sympathetic Hyperarousal (Racing Heart, Shallow Breathing, Rapid Pacing)',
          quote: "Everyone is setting me up to fail! You don't have my back, executive leadership changed the target three times this week, and I honestly can't breathe in this room right now.",
          options: [
            {
              id: 'A',
              text: "The Accidental Therapist: 'Alex, tell me everything that's making you feel this way. Is this triggered by what happened with your parents or your previous toxic boss?'",
              type: 'danger',
              score: 2,
              responseState: 'Severe Autonomic Flood / Loss of Containment',
              feedbackTitle: 'Dangerous Boundary Violation (The Accidental Therapist Trap)',
              feedback: "Probing for traumatic roots crosses strict professional boundaries and forces an uncontained survivor into emotional flooding during a professional evaluation. Managers must remain relational anchors, not amateur psychotherapists."
            },
            {
              id: 'B',
              text: "The Defensive Policy Enforcer: 'Alex, calm down immediately. If you leave this office or speak to me in that tone, I will have no choice but to file a formal insubordination report.'",
              type: 'danger',
              score: 1,
              responseState: 'Dorsal Vagal Collapse / Hostile Fight Escalation',
              feedbackTitle: 'Threat Escalation & Traumatic Coercion',
              feedback: "Trauma strips away agency. Meeting acute hyperarousal with institutional ultimatums reinforces the neuroception of active threat, guaranteeing either explosive fight escalation or complete psychological shutdown."
            },
            {
              id: 'C',
              text: "Trauma-Informed Attuned Agency: 'I hear how completely overwhelmed you are right now, Alex. Let's pause our review immediately. Would you like to step outside for 10 minutes of quiet, or should we reschedule for tomorrow morning?'",
              type: 'success',
              score: 10,
              responseState: 'Ventral Vagal Down-Regulation / Restored Agency',
              feedbackTitle: 'Exemplary Trauma-Informed Co-Regulation (Score: 10/10)',
              feedback: "1. Regulates Before Reasoning: Pauses cognitive demands while the nervous system is in survival triage. 2. Restores Agency: Offers clear, low-demanding choices (pause vs. reschedule) to reverse traumatic powerlessness. 3. Maintains Professional Boundary: Provides compassionate containment without psychoanalyzing."
            }
          ]
        },
        flashback: {
          id: 'flashback',
          title: 'Intrusive Recall in Public Space',
          role: 'Jordan (Partner / Close Friend)',

          initialAutonomic: 'Subcortical Threat Intrusion / Loss of Present-Day Timestamp',
          quote: "(Gripping the table with white knuckles, staring blankly at the door) We need to leave right this second. He's here. Something horrific is going to happen to us.",
          options: [
            {
              id: 'A',

              type: 'danger',

              feedback: "In traumatic intrusion, subcortical survival alarms override hippocampal context. Telling someone 'it's just a delivery guy' invalidates their visceral terror, forcing them to fight both their internal threat and your disbelief."
            },
            {
              id: 'B',
              text: "Investigative Interrogation: 'Who do you see? What did he look like? Did something happen to you in a restaurant like this before? Tell me everything!'",
              type: 'danger',
              score: 2,
              responseState: 'Narrative Flashback Flooding / Hyperventilation',
              feedbackTitle: 'Accidental Re-traumatization: Investigative Probing',
              feedback: "Interrogating a person experiencing an intrusion pulls unindexed sensory fragments into conscious awareness without grounding, precipitating a full dissociated panic attack."
            },
            {
              id: 'C',
              text: "Somatic Dual-Awareness Anchor: (Lowering vocal pitch, non-demanding posture) 'I hear you, Jordan. You are with me, and we are safe right now. Feel both of your feet flat on the floor. I am right beside you. Would you like to walk outside to the patio together?'",
              type: 'success',
              score: 10,
              responseState: 'Ventral Vagal Anchoring / Re-established Present-Day Reality',
              feedbackTitle: 'Masterful Dual Awareness Grounding (Score: 10/10)',
              feedback: "1. Somatic Timestamping: Grounds the survivor in present physical reality (feet on floor, hearing a calm voice). 2. Relational Co-Regulation: 'You are with me.' 3. Voluntary Agency: Gives choice to move outside together rather than dragging or invalidating."
            }
          ]
        },
        accountability: {
          id: 'accountability',
          title: 'The Explanation vs. Excuse Dilemma',
          role: 'Marcus (Colleague / Peer Contributor)',
          setting: 'Project retro after Marcus missed a critical client delivery and yelled at a junior colleague',
          initialAutonomic: 'Defensive Guilt & Protective Shielding',
          quote: "You have no right to lecture me about that deadline. You know I have PTSD from my military deployment and my childhood. My nervous system was triggered, so you need to accommodate my trauma.",
          options: [
            {
              id: 'A',
              text: "Unconditional Collusion: 'You are totally right, Marcus. I am so sorry for bringing it up. Don't worry about the client or how you talked to Sara—your mental health comes first.'",
              type: 'danger',
              score: 2,
              responseState: 'Erosion of Safety / Weaponized Vulnerability',
              feedbackTitle: 'Enabling Harm: Dropping Accountability',
              feedback: "Treating trauma as an excuse that removes personal agency harms the broader community and stunts the individual's growth. Healthy trauma-informed systems never sacrifice community safety or peer dignity."
            },
            {
              id: 'B',
              text: "Punitive Rejection: 'I don't care about your military service or your childhood. We have a business to run, and if you can't control your emotions, you shouldn't be working here.'",
              type: 'danger',
              score: 1,
              responseState: 'Shame Spiral & Institutional Betrayal',
              feedbackTitle: 'Hostile Invalidation & Retraumatization',

            },
            {

              text: "The Compassion-AND-Accountability Bridge: 'Marcus, I deeply honor the combat and developmental adversity you survived, and I understand how intensely your threat alarms can fire. AND, speaking to Sara that way and missing that deadline impacted the whole team. How can we build an early warning system so you get support before overwhelm leads to harm?'",
              type: 'success',
              score: 10,
              responseState: 'Collaborative Problem-Solving / Restored Dignity',

          ]
        },
        classroom: {

          title: 'Adolescent Shutdown & Equifinality',

          initialAutonomic: 'Dorsal Vagal Shutdown (Head down, non-verbal, hoodie pulled low)',
          quote: "(Slumped over desk, refusing to take out notebook or look at teacher. When nudged, mumbles: 'Leave me alone. I don't give a damn about this stupid class.')",
          options: [

              feedbackTitle: 'Punitive Escalation: Coercing a Shut-Down System',

I left a clipboard with the microscope slides on the side counter. You can work over there solo, or just take 10 minutes to reset. Which works better for you right now?'",
              type: 'success',
              score: 10,

      };

      const activeSim = scenarios[state.simScenarioId] || scenarios.workplace;
      const history = state.simHistory[activeSim.id];

      return `
        <div class="space-y-8 pb-12">

            <p class="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#2F3F48] dark:text-stone-300 max-w-3xl leading-relaxed">

            </p>
          </div>

          <!-- Scenario Navigation Tabs -->
          <div class="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5">
            ${Object.values(scenarios).map(sc => {
              const isSel = state.simScenarioId === sc.id;
              const hasCompleted = state.simHistory[sc.id] !== undefined;
              return `
                <button onclick="switchSimScenario('${sc.id}')" class="p-3.5 rounded-2xl text-left border transition flex flex-col justify-between space-y-2 ${isSel ? 'bg-[#3e6892] text-white border-transparent ring-2 ring-[#3e6892]/30 shadow-md' : 'bg-white dark:bg-stone-800 border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 text-stone-700 dark:text-stone-200 hover:border-[#3e6892]'}">
                  <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span class="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase font-bold tracking-wider ${isSel ? 'text-[#edae9d]' : 'text-stone-400'}">${hasCompleted ? '✓ Completed' : 'Scenario'}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <div class="font-serif-editorial font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm leading-tight">${sc.title}</div>
                    <div class="text-[10px] ${isSel ? 'text-stone-200' : 'text-stone-400'} mt-0.5">${sc.role.split('(')[0]}</div>

          <!-- Active Scenario Simulation Arena -->
          <div class="p-6 sm:p-10 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-stone-800 border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 shadow-xl space-y-6">

                    return simImgs[activeSim.id] || coursePhotos.hero;

                </div>
              </div>

              <!-- Autonomic Telemetry Gauge -->
              <div class="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-stone-100 dark:bg-stone-900 border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
                <i data-lucide="activity" class="w-4 h-4 text-[#edae9d]"></i>
                <div>
                  <div class="text-[9.5px] uppercase font-mono font-bold text-stone-500">Live Autonomic State</div>
                  <div class="font-semibold text-[#172126] dark:text-stone-200">${history ? history.responseState : activeSim.initialAutonomic}</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Dialogue Speech Bubble -->
            <div class="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-[#FFF9F6] dark:bg-stone-900/80 border-l-4 border-[#edae9d] space-y-2 shadow-sm">

              <p class="font-serif-editorial text-lg sm:text-xl italic text-[#172126] dark:text-[#FAF6F7] leading-relaxed">

            <!-- Decision Options -->
            <div class="space-y-3 pt-2">

              <div class="space-y-2.5">

'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 border-emerald-500 ring-2 ring-emerald-500/30' : 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/30 border-rose-500 ring-2 ring-rose-500/30') : 'bg-white dark:bg-stone-800/90 border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 hover:border-[#3e6892] dark:hover:border-stone-500 shadow-sm'}">
                      <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span class="text-xs font-bold font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded ${isChosen ? 'bg-[#3e6892] text-white' : 'bg-stone-100 dark:bg-stone-700 text-stone-600 dark:text-stone-300'}">Option ${opt.id}</span>
                        ${isChosen ? `<span class="text-xs font-bold ${opt.score === 10 ? 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300' : 'text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300'}">Score: ${opt.score}/10</span>` : ''}
                      </div>
                      <div class="text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium leading-relaxed text-[#172126] dark:text-stone-200">${opt.text}</div>

                }).join('')}
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Dynamic Feedback & Neurobiological Rationale -->
            ${history ? `
              <div class="p-6 rounded-2xl border-2 ${history.score === 10 ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-50/90 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-100' : 'border-rose-400 bg-rose-50/90 dark:bg-rose-950/40 text-rose-950 dark:text-rose-100'} space-y-3 shadow-lg">
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between font-bold text-sm sm:text-base">

                  <span class="font-mono text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full ${history.score === 10 ? 'bg-emerald-200 text-emerald-900' : 'bg-rose-200 text-rose-900'}">Score: ${history.score} / 10</span>
                </div>
                <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm leading-relaxed">${history.feedback}</p>
                <div class="pt-3 border-t ${history.score === 10 ? 'border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800' : 'border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800'} flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                  <span class="font-semibold">Nervous System Shift: ${history.responseState}</span>
                  <button onclick="resetSimScenario('${activeSim.id}')" class="underline hover:opacity-80 font-bold">Try Another Response ↻</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ` : ''}
          </div>

          <!-- The "Shift the Question" Interactive Reframe Drill -->
          <div class="p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-stone-800 border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 shadow-xl space-y-6">
            <div>
              <span class="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest font-extrabold text-[#3e6892] dark:text-[#edae9d]">Interactive Communication Practice</span>

            </div>

            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              ${[
                {
                  id: 1,
                  deficit: "Why is this person so resistant and difficult about change?",

                  principle: "Decouples malice from defense; honors past environmental survival logic."
                },
                {
                  id: 2,
                  deficit: "Why can't they just let the past go and move on?",
                  reframe: "How is their subcortical threat brain still treating an unindexed past memory as an active present reality?",
                  principle: "Recognizes the neurobiology of missing hippocampal timestamps in intrusive recall."
                },
                {
                  id: 3,
                  deficit: "Why are they overreacting to minor constructive feedback?",
                  reframe: "Did early relational adversity teach them that any criticism signals impending abandonment or punishment?",
                  principle: "Identifies early attachment conditioning and salience network hypersensitivity."
                },
                {
                  id: 4,
                  deficit: "Why do they keep isolating and pushing everyone away?",
                  reframe: "How did emotional isolation serve as an intelligent survival bunker in an abusive or volatile household?",
                  principle: "Reframes antisocial withdrawal as protective armor before inviting reconnection."
                }
              ].map(card => `
                <div class="p-5 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 bg-stone-50/50 dark:bg-stone-900/50 space-y-3">
                  <div class="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <i data-lucide="x-circle" class="w-3.5 h-3.5"></i> Deficit Inquiry (Reflexive)
                  </div>
                  <div class="text-sm font-semibold text-stone-800 dark:text-stone-200">"${card.deficit}"</div>
                  
                  <div class="pt-2 border-t border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 space-y-1">
                    <div class="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <i data-lucide="check-circle" class="w-3.5 h-3.5"></i> Trauma-Informed Reframe
                    </div>
                    <div class="text-sm font-bold text-[#3e6892] dark:text-[#bbd4c5]">"${card.reframe}"</div>
                    <div class="text-[11px] text-stone-500 dark:text-stone-400 italic pt-1">Principle: ${card.principle}</div>

    function chooseSimOption(scId, optId) {
      const scenarios = {
        workplace: {
          options: [
            { id: 'A', score: 2, responseState: 'Severe Autonomic Flood / Loss of Containment', feedbackTitle: 'Dangerous Boundary Violation (The Accidental Therapist Trap)', feedback: 'Probing for traumatic roots crosses professional boundaries and forces an uncontained survivor into emotional flooding during a performance review.' },
            { id: 'B', score: 1, responseState: 'Dorsal Vagal Collapse / Hostile Fight Escalation', feedbackTitle: 'Threat Escalation & Traumatic Coercion', feedback: 'Trauma strips away agency. Meeting acute hyperarousal with institutional ultimatums reinforces active threat, guaranteeing fight escalation or shutdown.' },
            { id: 'C', score: 10, responseState: 'Ventral Vagal Down-Regulation / Restored Agency', feedbackTitle: 'Exemplary Trauma-Informed Co-Regulation (Score: 10/10)', feedback: 'Pauses cognitive demands while in survival triage, restores agency with micro-choices, and maintains compassionate professional containment.' }
          ]
        },
        flashback: {
          options: [
            { id: 'A', score: 2, responseState: 'Cognitive Severing / Deepened Panic', feedbackTitle: 'Harmful Invalidation: Logic Cannot Override Amygdala Alarms', feedback: 'Telling someone who is in a flashback to look around logically invalidates their terror, forcing them to fight both threat and disbelief.' },
            { id: 'B', score: 2, responseState: 'Narrative Flashback Flooding / Hyperventilation', feedbackTitle: 'Accidental Re-traumatization: Investigative Probing', feedback: 'Interrogating an active intrusion pulls unindexed sensory fragments into conscious awareness without grounding, deepening panic.' },
            { id: 'C', score: 10, responseState: 'Ventral Vagal Anchoring / Re-established Present Reality', feedbackTitle: 'Masterful Dual Awareness Grounding (Score: 10/10)', feedback: 'Grounds the survivor in present physical reality, offers relational co-regulation, and gives clear choice without dragging or interrogating.' }
          ]
        },
        accountability: {
          options: [
            { id: 'A', score: 2, responseState: 'Erosion of Safety / Weaponized Vulnerability', feedbackTitle: 'Enabling Harm: Dropping Accountability', feedback: 'Treating trauma as an excuse that removes personal agency harms the broader community and stunts the individual\'s growth.' },
            { id: 'B', score: 1, responseState: 'Shame Spiral & Institutional Betrayal', feedbackTitle: 'Hostile Invalidation & Retraumatization', feedback: 'Bluntly dismissing traumatic suffering confirms the survivor\'s fear that honesty leads to rejection, entrenching defensive armor.' },
            { id: 'C', score: 10, responseState: 'Collaborative Problem-Solving / Restored Dignity', feedbackTitle: 'The Compassion-AND-Accountability Standard (Score: 10/10)', feedback: 'Holds unconditional compassion for why the survival reflex exists while upholding firm, unwavering boundaries for current relational impact.' }
          ]
        },
        classroom: {
          options: [
            { id: 'A', score: 1, responseState: 'Defensive Mobilization / Public Humiliation', feedbackTitle: 'Punitive Escalation: Coercing a Shut-Down System', feedback: 'Dorsal shutdown is an involuntary biological defense. Demanding compliance in front of peers forces an adolescent system into desperate fight behaviors.' },
            { id: 'B', score: 2, responseState: 'Severe Mortification & Social Alienation', feedbackTitle: 'Boundary Violation: Amateur Diagnosis in Class', feedback: 'Exposing personal vulnerability or speculating about home trauma in front of peers inflicts social damage and violates relational privacy.' },
            { id: 'C', score: 10, responseState: 'Gradual Return to Window of Tolerance', feedbackTitle: 'Trauma-Informed Pedagogical Attunement (Score: 10/10)', feedback: 'Removes public spotlight, offers non-demanding proximity, and gives micro-choices that return agency without punitive failure.' }
          ]
        }
      };

      const sc = scenarios[scId];
      if (sc) {
        const opt = sc.options.find(o => o.id === optId);
        if (opt) {
          state.simHistory[scId] = {
            chosenOptId: optId,
            score: opt.score,
            responseState: opt.responseState,
            feedbackTitle: opt.feedbackTitle,
            feedback: opt.feedback
          };
          renderView();
          if (window.lucide) lucide.createIcons();
        }
      }
    }

    function saveLearningMapNote(id) {
      const val = document.getElementById(`lm-note-${id}`)?.value;

    function exportLearningMapNotes() {
      let text = "THE HUMAN AFTERMATH: MY LEARNING MAP\n\n";
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(state.learningMapNotes)) {
        text += `[${k.toUpperCase()}]\n${v}\n\n`;
      }
      const blob = new Blob([text], { type: 'text/plain' });
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      a.download = 'my_learning_map_notes.txt';
      a.click();
    }

    function filterGlossary() {

      const filtered = glossaryData.filter(g => g.term.toLowerCase().includes(q) || g.def.toLowerCase().includes(q) || g.category.toLowerCase().includes(q));
      
      c.innerHTML = filtered.map(g => `
        <div class="p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700 bg-[#FAF6F7] dark:bg-stone-800 space-y-1">

        </div>
      `).join('');
    }

    
    // Web Audio Synthesizer
    let audioCtx = null;
    let droneOsc1 = null;
    let droneOsc2 = null;
    let droneGain = null;

    function toggleAmbientSound() {
      const icon = document.getElementById('ambient-sound-icon');
      if (!state.ambientSoundActive) {
        try {
          const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
          if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new AudioContext();
          if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();

          droneGain = audioCtx.createGain();
          droneGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
          droneGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.035, audioCtx.currentTime + 2);
          droneGain.connect(audioCtx.destination);

          droneOsc1 = audioCtx.createOscillator();
          droneOsc1.type = 'sine';
          droneOsc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(108, audioCtx.currentTime);
          droneOsc1.connect(droneGain);
          droneOsc1.start();

          droneOsc2 = audioCtx.createOscillator();
          droneOsc2.type = 'sine';
          droneOsc2.frequency.setValueAtTime(216, audioCtx.currentTime);
          droneOsc2.connect(droneGain);
          droneOsc2.start();

          state.ambientSoundActive = true;
          if (icon) icon.setAttribute('data-lucide', 'volume-2');
        } catch(e) {
          console.warn("Web Audio blocked or unavailable.");
        }
      } else {
        if (droneGain && audioCtx) {
          droneGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
          setTimeout(() => {
            if (droneOsc1) { droneOsc1.stop(); droneOsc1.disconnect(); }
            if (droneOsc2) { droneOsc2.stop(); droneOsc2.disconnect(); }
            droneOsc1 = null;
            droneOsc2 = null;
          }, 500);
        }
        state.ambientSoundActive = false;
        if (icon) icon.setAttribute('data-lucide', 'volume-x');
      }
      if (window.lucide) lucide.createIcons();
    }

          ${media && media.recap_vimeo_id ? `

          <div class="p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-3xl bg-[#172126] text-white shadow-2xl border border-white/10 space-y-4">

              </div>
              ${media.alt_recap_vimeo_id ? `
              <div class="flex items-center bg-stone-800 rounded-lg p-0.5 border border-stone-700 gap-1">
                <button onclick="document.getElementById('recap-vimeo-${modNum}').src='https://player.vimeo.com/video/${media.recap_vimeo_id}?badge=0&autopause=0&player_id=0&app_id=58479'" class="px-3 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold bg-[#3E6892] text-white transition">
                  Recap 6A (${media.recap_duration})
                </button>
                <button onclick="document.getElementById('recap-vimeo-${modNum}').src='https://player.vimeo.com/video/${media.alt_recap_vimeo_id}?badge=0&autopause=0&player_id=0&app_id=58479'" class="px-3 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold text-stone-300 hover:text-white transition">
                  Recap 6B (${media.alt_recap_duration})
                </button>
              </div>
              ` : ``}
            </div>
            <div class="relative rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-black aspect-video flex items-center justify-center shadow-2xl border border-white/10">
              <iframe id="recap-vimeo-${modNum}" src="https://player.vimeo.com/video/${media.recap_vimeo_id}?badge=0&autopause=0&player_id=0&app_id=58479" class="w-full h-full border-0" allow="autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe>
            </div>
            <p class="text-xs text-stone-300 leading-relaxed pt-1">${media.summary}</p>
          </div>
          ` : ``}

          <div class="p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-stone-800 border-2 border-[#D2CACF] dark:border-stone-700 shadow-md space-y-4">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
              <i data-lucide="disc" class="w-5 h-5 text-[#EDAE9D]"></i>
              <h3 class="font-serif-editorial text-xl font-bold text-[#172126] dark:text-white">Module ${modNum} Full-Circle Moment</h3>
            </div>
            <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#172126] dark:text-stone-300 leading-relaxed font-medium">
              What becomes visible when we consider these lessons together? An event is never the complete story. Whether examining stress physiology, memory shards, attachment styles, or coping armor, human responses are intelligent evolutionary survival adaptations shaped by context.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div class="p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-3xl bg-[#FBF3F5] dark:bg-rose-950/20 border-2 border-rose-400 space-y-3">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
              <i data-lucide="alert-triangle" class="w-5 h-5 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300"></i>
              <h3 class="font-bold text-sm text-[#814A57] dark:text-rose-200 uppercase tracking-wider">Module ${modNum} Misconception Challenge</h3>
            </div>
            <div class="text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#172126] dark:text-stone-200 leading-relaxed">
              <strong>The Common Myth:</strong> "If someone experienced an objectively terrible event, their ongoing emotional struggles prove that their brain is permanently broken."<br><br>
              <strong>The Scientific Correction:</strong> Exposure is probabilistic, not deterministic. Brain networks retain lifelong neuroplasticity, and human recovery is heavily co-produced by subsequent relational safety, economic resources, and environmental buffers.
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="p-6 bg-white dark:bg-stone-800 rounded-2xl border-2 border-[#D2CACF] flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 shadow-sm">
            <div>
              <div class="font-bold text-sm text-[#172126] dark:text-white">Ready for the Next Chapter?</div>
              <div class="text-xs text-stone-500">Advance to Module ${modNum < 8 ? modNum + 1 : 'Completion Certificate'}</div>
            </div>
            <button onclick="advanceToNextModule(${modNum})" class="px-8 py-3.5 bg-[#2C4A68] hover:bg-[#172126] text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-2 shadow-md">
              <span>Continue to Module ${modNum < 8 ? modNum + 1 : 'Certificate'}</span>
              <i data-lucide="arrow-right" class="w-4 h-4 text-[#FFD2C6]"></i>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function advanceToNextModule(currentModNum) {
      if (currentModNum < courseData.length) {
        navigateTo('lesson', currentModNum, 0);
      } else {
        navigateTo('certificate');
      }
    }

    window.onload = function() {
      renderView();
      renderSidebar();
      filterGlossary();
      updateProgressUI();
      if (window.lucide) lucide.createIcons();
    };
  </script>

<script>(function(){
  function nameOf(el){return (el.getAttribute('aria-label')||el.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')||el.textContent||'').trim();}
  function labelFor(el){
    var oc=el.getAttribute('onclick')||'', m;
    if(/toggleSidebar/.test(oc)) return 'Toggle course menu';
    if((m=oc.match(/toggleModal\('modal-([a-z-]+)'\)/))) return 'Open or close '+m[1].replace(/-/g,' ');
    var svg=el.querySelector('svg');
    if(svg){var c=[].slice.call(svg.classList).filter(function(x){return /^lucide-/.test(x);})[0]; if(c) return c.replace('lucide-','').replace(/-/g,' ');}
    return el.title||'';
  }
  function enhance(){
    document.querySelectorAll('svg.lucide').forEach(function(s){s.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');s.setAttribute('focusable','false');});
    document.querySelectorAll('button,a[href],[role=button]').forEach(function(el){
      if(!nameOf(el)){var l=labelFor(el); if(l) el.setAttribute('aria-label',l);}
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('input,textarea,select').forEach(function(el){
      if(el.type==='hidden'||el.getAttribute('aria-label')||el.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')) return;
      if(el.id && document.querySelector('label[for="'+el.id+'"]')) return;
      var l=el.placeholder||el.id.replace(/[-_]/g,' ').replace(/\binput\b/,'').trim();
      if(l) el.setAttribute('aria-label',l.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+l.slice(1));
    });
    var pr=document.getElementById('top-nav-progress');
    if(pr){pr.setAttribute('role','progressbar');pr.setAttribute('aria-label','Course progress');
      var v=parseInt(pr.textContent,10)||0; pr.setAttribute('aria-valuemin','0');pr.setAttribute('aria-valuemax','100');pr.setAttribute('aria-valuenow',v);}
  }
  // dialogs
  var opener=null;
  document.querySelectorAll('[id^="modal-"]').forEach(function(m){
    m.setAttribute('role','dialog');m.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');
    var h=m.querySelector('h1,h2,h3'); if(h){if(!h.id)h.id=m.id+'-title'; m.setAttribute('aria-labelledby',h.id);}
  });
  var orig=window.toggleModal;
  if(typeof orig==='function'){
    window.toggleModal=function(id){
      var el=document.getElementById(id), wasOpen=el&&!el.classList.contains('hidden');
      if(!wasOpen) opener=document.activeElement;
      var r=orig.apply(this,arguments);
      if(el){
        if(!wasOpen){var f=el.querySelector('input,button,[href],textarea,select'); if(f) setTimeout(function(){f.focus();},30);}
        else if(opener&&opener.focus){opener.focus();}
      }
      return r;
    };
  }
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    var open=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('[id^="modal-"]')).filter(function(m){return !m.classList.contains('hidden');})[0];
    if(!open) return;
    if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();window.toggleModal(open.id);return;}
    if(e.key==='Tab'){
      var f=[].slice.call(open.querySelectorAll('a[href],button:not([disabled]),input,textarea,select,[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])')).filter(function(x){return x.offsetParent!==null;});
      if(!f.length) return;
      var first=f[0], last=f[f.length-1];
      if(e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===first){e.preventDefault();last.focus();}
      else if(!e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===last){e.preventDefault();first.focus();}
    }
  });
  // view changes: announce + move focus (not on first load)
  var vc=document.getElementById('view-container'), lastHead=null, ready=false;
  var live=document.createElement('div'); live.setAttribute('aria-live','polite'); live.className='sr-only-live'; document.body.appendChild(live);
  function onView(){
    enhance();
    var h=vc&&vc.querySelector('h1,h2'); var t=h?h.textContent.trim():'';
    if(t&&t!==lastHead){
      lastHead=t;
      if(ready){live.textContent=''; setTimeout(function(){live.textContent='Now showing: '+t;},50);
        if(h){h.setAttribute('tabindex','-1'); h.focus({preventScroll:true});}}
    }
  }
  if(vc){new MutationObserver(onView).observe(vc,{childList:true,subtree:false});}
  new MutationObserver(enhance).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true});
  enhance(); onView(); setTimeout(function(){ready=true;},800);
  // honor OS reduced-motion preference
  try{
    var t=document.getElementById('reduced-motion-toggle');
    if(t&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches&&!t.checked){t.checked=true; if(typeof toggleReducedMotion==='function') toggleReducedMotion();}
  }catch(e){}
})();
